description: A real latitude/longitude point symbol map: Longitude and Latitude measure columns are placed on Cols/Rows as AVG continuous axes, one Circle mark per detail dimension member. Size, color, and tooltip are optional and remain absent unless the ask explicitly assigns fields to those encodings. Use for datasets that already carry real coordinate columns rather than Tableau-generated geocoding fields.

slots.notes: Real longitude measure column, aggregated as AVG and placed on Columns as [avg:Longitude:qk].
Real latitude measure column, aggregated as AVG and placed on Rows as [avg:Latitude:qk].

First grain dimension on the level-of-detail shelf as [none:Detail1:nk]. kind:'geo' is a binder-internal routing label so an UNBOUND detail2 prunes via the same optional-geo-LOD path as spatial-symbol-map; the emitted <lod> XML carries NO semantic-role, so Tableau does NOT geocode it (these are real coordinate columns, not generated geo fields). The dedicated resolveLatLonSymbolMap binds this directly, bypassing generic name-affinity routing.

Second grain dimension as [none:Detail2:nk]. OPTIONAL: bound when the data has a second non-coordinate dimension so no marks collapse (e.g. pm_name AND city — 26 offices stay 26 marks, not per-city AVG-centroids). When the data has only ONE dimension this slot is UNBOUND and pruned (bindable && !required && kind:'geo' && role:['lod'] — the exact optionalFieldPrunesFor predicate). Data with 3+ non-coordinate dims exceeds this template's capacity and fails closed to propose (dropping a dim would re-collapse marks).

slots.purpose: Optional measure that controls symbol size.
slots.notes: OPTIONAL: binds only from an explicit size shelf instruction. When unbound, its datasource declaration and size encoding are removed byte-identically.

slots.purpose: Optional measure or dimension that controls mark color.
slots.notes: OPTIONAL: binds only from an explicit color shelf instruction. Categorical fields use derivation none; measures use the requested or default sum aggregation.

slots.purpose: Optional measure or dimension added to the mark tooltip.
slots.notes: OPTIONAL: binds only from an explicit tooltip shelf instruction. Categorical fields use derivation none; measures use the requested or default sum aggregation.

hazards.detail: CLOSED: a dedicated coordinate-affinity resolver in classify.ts (resolveLatLonSymbolMap) binds longitude→cols / latitude→rows by field-NAME affinity, never generic role-greedy quant order, and fails closed on any ambiguity. The axis-swap regression is locked by the mandatory reversed-schema-order test in binder.test.ts (Blake wall #2). The generic role-greedy path is bypassed for this template.
UNKNOWN: shipped map templates use generated Latitude/Longitude with mapsources; no committed real-measure lat/lon map precedent proves map layer behavior before live render/readback.
